text:
Maria Chen: quick brain dump — proposing a staggered design-partner recruitment experiment next quarter. goal: reduce onboarding churn and get early signal on perf/cost tradeoffs before wider beta. thoughts?

Jin Park: love it. can you share cohorts + gating criteria?

Maria Chen: high level — 3 cohorts over 6 weeks: 1) integrators (SDK + infra teams) — 8 partners; 2) high-volume app teams (chat/search) — 10 partners; 3) compliance-sensitive (enterprise/legal) — 4 partners. gating: acceptance questionnaire, short tech smoke, signed NDA for cohort 3.

Alex Rivera: recommend adding a quick workload fingerprint step (10 sample requests) so we can pick quantization + batching profiles early. low overhead.

Priya Sharma: +1. also propose feedback cadence: weekly short form (5 Qs) + biweekly 30m interview for first month, then monthly. capture qual + perf metrics.

Sam O'Neill: for incentives we should offer 3 months of discounted dedicated capacity for integrators and high-volume. cohort 3 gets SOC2 readiness consults.

Devon Li: success criteria from CS pov: <2 escalations per partner in month 1, NPS >= 7, and clear adoption signal (x number of routes migrated). otherwise rollback.

Maria Chen: noted. rough launch criteria checklist:```
- onboarding docs completed
- 2 successful smoke runs per partner
- perf baseline measured (latency, cost per token)
- feedback loop wired into console (alerts + tag)
- fallback model policy defined
```

Jin Park: timeline OK? 6 week stagger: cohort 1 start week 1, cohort 2 start week 3, cohort 3 start week 5, each runs 8 weeks. gives overlap for learnings.

Alex Rivera: capacity ask for eng: we'll need 2 GPU pools reserved for cohort peaks. can we get approval from infra? @deploy-bot can you open a capacity request ticket?

deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4821 for "DP cohort GPU pool reservation" — assignee: eng-infra. ETA: 3 business days. :white_check_mark:

Priya Sharma: measurement plan: we'll track latency P95, cost/token, error rates, prompt-quality regressions (via eval harness) and qualitative themes. attach baseline prompt set to partner onboarding.

Sam O'Neill: small ask — can we surface per-partner cost heatmaps in console for them? it's a big conversion driver.

Maria Chen: agreed. add to scope as "must have" for cohort 2, "nice to have" for cohort 1.

Devon Li: final negotiation note: partners may ask to widen scope mid-cohort. default stance: freeze scope for first 3 weeks, then accept 1 scoped change request with timeline impact.

Jin Park: ok decision. action items: 1) Maria draft partner invite + gating survey (due EOD Fri). 2) Alex confirm infra capacity (INFRA-4821). 3) Priya assemble eval prompt set. 4) Sam draft incentives doc. 5) Devon prepare CS playbook for onboarding.

Maria Chen: i'll post the invite draft in #product-drafts later today. thanks all :thumbsup:
